how_to_apply: Fill in the bio-data proforma (Annexure-A), which comes with the notice, and sign it. It asks for details such as date of birth, date of entry into service and retirement, a chronological employment record with pay scales and duties, present emoluments, and the nature of present employment. It also covers additional qualifications, training, achievements (publications, awards, patents) and whether you are SC/ST.
Get the application countersigned by your employer or cadre controlling authority, with seal.

The sponsoring authority forwards the application with the required certificates and documents to the Under Secretary (Administration), Department of Water Resources, RD & GR, Shram Shakti Bhawan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi, within the extended period.
You may email an advance copy to [email protected] or [email protected].
What the sponsoring authority certifies or encloses:
the particulars given by the applicant are correct
no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending or contemplated against the applicant
no major or minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years, or a list of such penalties is enclosed
photocopies of the APARs for the last five (5) years, attested on each page by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent
Officers already on deputation must have their applications forwarded by the parent cadre or department, along with Cadre Clearance, Vigilance Clearance and an Integrity certificate.
Reasons for rejection: applications that do not arrive in hard copy through proper channel, arrive after the prescribed date, or lack the required certificates or documents will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: About DoWR
content_sections.text: The Department of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation is a department of the Ministry of Jal Shakti, Government of India. Its Administration Section works from Shram Shakti Bhawan, Rafi Marg, New Delhi, and issued this vacancy circular.

content_sections.heading: DoWR Senior Joint Commissioner (Agricultural Discipline) Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The post belongs to the General Central Service and is Group 'A', Gazetted and Non-Ministerial. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

content_sections.heading: DoWR Senior Joint Commissioner (Agricultural Discipline) Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: For appointment by deputation (including short term contract), the age limit is 56 years, counted on the closing date for receipt of applications. Officers of the Central Government, State Governments, Union Territories Administration, Public Sector Undertakings, universities, recognised research institutions or autonomous or statutory organisations who meet both conditions below. (a) Service: holding an analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or five years' service in the grade after regular appointment in Level 12 (Rs. 78800-209200) of the Pay Matrix, or equivalent, in the parent cadre or department. (b) Educational qualification (essential): Graduate Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Soil and Water Conservation Engineering from a recognised University or Institute; or Post Graduate Degree in Agronomy, Soil Science, Environment, Geo-technical, Water Resources, Hydraulics Development or Irrigation Water Development from a recognised University or Institute. Experience (essential): twelve years' experience in water conservation, water management, planning of irrigated agriculture or on-farm development work in one of these: the irrigation or agricultural department of a State or Union territory Administration or the Central Government a recognised agricultural University an agricultural training, research or management institute the Water Engineering Services of the Central Government See the official notification for the full eligibility wording for this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The selected officer can choose between two options. One is to draw pay in the parent cadre's pay matrix plus deputation (duty) allowance. The other is to have pay fixed in the pay matrix of the deputation post. Both are subject to DoPT O.M. No. 6/8/2009-Estt (Pay-II) dated 17.06.2010, as amended from time to time. The total period of deputation (including short term contract) shall ordinarily not exceed five (05) years. This includes any deputation in another ex-cadre post held immediately before this appointment, in the same or another organisation or department of the Central Government. If selected, the officer's employer certifies that he or she will be relieved immediately.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Selection Committee assesses the information in the bio-data, together with the documents on essential qualification and work experience, at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q1. Has the last date for the Senior Joint Commissioner post been extended again?
faq.answer: Yes. The letter of 29.10.2026 extends it by 30 days from the date of publication in Employment News. This follows the extensions of 20.07.2026 and 09.09.2026.

faq.question: Q2. Can a fresh graduate apply for this post?
faq.answer: No. Only serving officers can apply. They must hold an analogous post on regular basis, or have five years' regular service in Level 12 (Rs. 78800-209200), and also have twelve years' relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. Which degrees are accepted?
faq.answer: A Graduate Degree in Agricultural Engineering or Soil and Water Conservation Engineering. A Post Graduate Degree in Agronomy, Soil Science, Environment, Geo-technical, Water Resources, Hydraulics Development or Irrigation Water Development is also accepted.

faq.question: Q4. What kind of experience counts?
faq.answer: Twelve years in water conservation, water management, planning of irrigated agriculture or on-farm development work. It must be in a government irrigation or agricultural department, a recognised agricultural university, an agricultural training, research or management institute, or the Central Government's Water Engineering Services.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age?
faq.answer: 56 years, counted on the closing date for receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q6. How long does the deputation last?
faq.answer: Ordinarily not more than five (05) years in total. This includes any ex-cadre deputation held immediately before this appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Can I send my application only by email?
faq.answer: No. A hard copy must come through proper channel. Email to [email protected] or [email protected] is only for an advance copy.

faq.question: Q8. How many APARs must be attached?
faq.answer: Photocopies of the APARs for the last five years. Each page must be attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent.

faq.question: Q9. Whom can I call about the post?
faq.answer: The letter is signed by Saket Sourav, Under Secretary to the Govt. of India. His telephone number is 011-23738126.
